_note: Voices of the studio's voice-over (step 038; owner's casting 2026-11-19, re-cast 2026-11-22). A voice with a `recipe` is DESIGNED: VoxCPM2 makes every script from its style + seed (vendor/voxcpm_tts); <id>.wav is a sample to listen to (sample_text is what it says). A voice without one is CLONED from <id>.wav (card_text is what it says). `enabled` is the default of the owner's on/off (Voix page; the owner's choice lives in the studio's state and wins). use_for = the scenes the voice is for (the AI picks a voice per video from it); styles = the video styles the voice suits; address = tu / vous; gender picks the sitcom's character voices among the voices on (src/studio/voices.py say_cast).

voices.label: Souriante
voices.description: French woman, warm, bright and smiling, engaging storyteller with a steady lively pace.
voices.sample_text: Arrête de compter tes pas. Sérieux. Dix mille pas, c'est bien. Mais si tu manges trois cents calories de trop chaque soir, tu fais du surplace. Le vrai levier, c'est ton assiette.

recipe.style: warm, bright and smiling, engaging storyteller, steady lively pace

voices.use_for: Storytelling and explainers: a story told from start to end, how the body works, calm or warm moments, empathy (cravings, tiredness, doubts), evening and sleep topics. A woman's voice for a female persona.
